items.title: George Guesnon Interview, 1965-09
items.q: That's the band I went to Memphis with you see... This is Albert Warner. ... He took a heart attack out there on the job with us.

ctx.x: Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. That's a good picture. Yeah. That's a nice picture. Is this taking preservation? Yeah. Yeah. I made that three months ago just before we went to Memphis. Yeah. But was it this picture someone copied and made drawings of? Oh no no. It's a big old thing that you wouldn't know who it is. People sitting up there with a big old crooked mountain.

They ain't got, don't you see them pictures they got on the, some of them on the wall when you go and preservation. Oh yeah. You don't know one from the other. That's supposed to be so and so because somebody tell you that so and so. But you don't feel, see no facial resemblance you know. Uh huh. Oh no they won't bother. No. Yeah. That's the band I went to Memphis with you see. Memphis. Yeah you see that's Memphis Tennessee. We went there three months ago. Monday, May, June, July. Yeah August. Yeah. Four months…
